decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 5 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted for restaurant purpose shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme showing the noise levels to be generated by the A/C and Cold Room compressors (including any sound insulation measures) have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.
description: Installation of a new shop front, ventilation system and external compressors.
